# `/sp-config` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /sp-config/v1/export

`exportSpConfigV1` — Initiates configuration objects export job

This post will export objects from the tenant to a JSON configuration file. For more information about the object types that currently support export functionality, refer to [SaaS Configuration](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/extensibility/configuration-management/saas-configuration#supported-objects).

- Scopes: sp:config:manage, sp:config:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): exportpayload
- Returns 202: spconfigexportjob

### GET /sp-config/v1/export/{id}

`getSpConfigExportStatusV1` — Get export job status

This gets the status of the export job identified by the `id` parameter. The request will need one of the following security scopes: - sp:config:read - sp:config:manage

- Scopes: sp:config:manage, sp:config:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the export job whose status will be returned.
- Returns 200: spconfigexportjobstatus

### GET /sp-config/v1/export/{id}/download

`getSpConfigExportV1` — Download export job result.

This endpoint gets the export file resulting from the export job with the requested `id` and downloads it to a file. The request will need one of the following security scopes: - sp:config:read - sp:config:manage

- Scopes: sp:config:manage, sp:config:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the export job whose results will be downloaded.
- Returns 200: spconfigexportresults

### POST /sp-config/v1/import

`importSpConfigV1` — Initiates configuration objects import job

This post will import objects from a JSON configuration file into a tenant. By default, every import will first export all existing objects supported by sp-config as a backup before the import is attempted. The backup is provided so that the state of the configuration prior to the import is available for inspection or restore if needed. The backup can be skipped by setting "excludeBackup" to true in the import options. If a backup is performed, the id of the backup will be provided in the…

- Scopes: sp:config:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `preview` (query) — default False — This option is intended to give the user information about how an import operation would proceed, without having any effect on the target tenant. If this parameter is "true", no objects will be…
- Body (multipart/form-data): object
- Returns 202: spconfigjob

### GET /sp-config/v1/import/{id}

`getSpConfigImportStatusV1` — Get import job status

'This gets the status of the import job identified by the `id` parameter. For more information about the object types that currently support import functionality, refer to [SaaS Configuration](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/extensibility/configuration-management/saas-configuration#supported-objects).'

- Scopes: sp:config:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the import job whose status will be returned.
- Returns 200: spconfigimportjobstatus

### GET /sp-config/v1/import/{id}/download

`getSpConfigImportV1` — Download import job result

This gets import file resulting from the import job with the requested id and downloads it to a file. The downloaded file will contain the results of the import operation, including any error, warning or informational messages associated with the import. The request will need the following security scope: - sp:config:manage

- Scopes: sp:config:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the import job whose results will be downloaded.
- Returns 200: spconfigimportresults

### GET /sp-config/v1/config-objects

`listSpConfigObjectsV1` — List config objects

Get a list of object configurations that the tenant export/import service knows.

- Scopes: sp:config:manage, sp:config:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Returns 200: array of spconfigobject
